messages:
incident-bot: ALERT firing: synth-canary-checks APAC cluster - probe_failure_rate > 3% for 2m (group=synth-canary, severity=page) :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty page created: PD #INC123456 - Unacked for 2m - escalating to second oncall :bell:

maria (sre-oncall): acked PD INC123456 :white_check_mark: i'm on it. grabbing runbook + triage now. tagging eng-runtime.
jon (eng-runtime): thanks — i see a burst of 502s from the prober in apac-east. logs show repeated connection resets to our probe-runner pool. wondering if it's a prober-side regression or infra/network.
kevin (prod-ops): rolling up infra metrics — any recent deploys to synth-prober?
logan (eng-infra): there was a config flip yesterday on prober fanout multiplier (fanout.mult=1.0 -> 2.5) to improve coverage during tests. i reverted it in staging but didn't push prod update. checking if prod got the change via infra rollout.
maria (sre-oncall): good catch. can we temporarily reduce fanout or throttle synth traffic to stop noisy pages while we triage? want to avoid alert fatigue.
jon (eng-runtime): we can gate the prober via feature-flag. rolling a patch to set fanout.mult=1.0 in prod config map now. command: 
```
kubectl -n synth patch configmap prober-config -p '{"data":{"fanout.mult":"1.0"}}'
```
jon (eng-runtime): applying now, will restart prober pods if needed.

incident-bot: action acknowledged: config-patch started by jon. expected impact: reduce probe QPS by ~60%.

sarah (support): any customer-facing impact? I'm seeing a couple of support tickets mentioning intermittent slow responses from embedding endpoints in apac, opened 00:42 UTC.
olivia (pm): from product metrics: request success for generation endpoints in APAC shows a small uptick in 5xx-surfaced errors between 00:40-00:50 UTC but not widespread. looks like <0.3% of total traffic. keep me posted if that grows.

maria (sre-oncall): quick customer impact note for incident page: currently elevated synth probe failures only. we haven't seen a correlated rise in production 5xxs beyond noise, but support tickets exist. classify as 'potential customer impact — monitoring' for now.

logan (eng-infra): prod config map patch applied and prober pods rolling. watch logs: 
```
kubectl -n synth rollout status deploy/prober-runner
kubectl -n synth logs -l app=synthetic-prober --tail=200
```

jon (eng-runtime): after patch, initial metrics show probe failure rate dropping to 0.4% within 30s. PD auto-escalation window still open — can someone ack/resolve PD once we confirm stability?
kevin (prod-ops): i'm going to temporarily silence the page rule for synth-canary in PD for 15m to avoid blowups while we validate. will add annotation to incident record.
maria (sre-oncall): please add a link to the runbook in the incident. runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/synth-canary-triage

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: PD INC123456 silenced for 15m by kevin.

jon (eng-runtime): logs from prober after restart: 
```
[2026-03-15T00:55:21Z] prober: worker=7 send=ok latency=130ms target=apac-east
[2026-03-15T00:55:22Z] prober: worker=3 send=ok latency=140ms target=apac-east
[2026-03-15T00:55:23Z] prober: connection_reset_count=0
```

maria (sre-oncall): failure rate back to baseline ~0.2% and no new support tickets in the last 10m. i'm resolving the page in PD.
pagerduty-bot: PD INC123456 marked resolved by maria.

olivia (pm): thanks team. next steps: 1) schedule a follow-up postmortem to decide whether feature-flag gating should be permanent for fanout changes, 2) confirm we have a safe rollout path for prober config changes (canary the config), 3) notify customers in apac if we see any delayed errors.
sarah (support): i'll draft a short status note for customers and hold until we confirm no additional errors.
jon (eng-runtime): root-cause hypothesis: aggressive prober fanout caused transient connection exhaustion in a subset of probe-runner instances -> manifested as probe failures and a small number of prod-facing escalations. will instrument connection pool metrics and add a safety cap.
maria (sre-oncall): tagging this incident as 'synth-prober-fanout-noise' in trackers. assigning follow-up owners: jon for runtime fix, logan for rollout gating, olivia for customer comms decision.

maria (sre-oncall): handing off to kevin for next shift at 01:00 UTC. kevin, you're the new oncall owner for any late regressions — ping in #incidents if anything re-fires. :wave:
kevin (prod-ops): acknowledged handoff. i'll keep the PD rule temp-silence if we re-open within the 15m window.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed (no active pages). summary: temporary surge in synth probe failures due to higher fanout; mitigated by config rollback; minor customer noise (<0.3%); follow-ups recorded.
